anubarak.note: Beetle spam build, dive their backline
anubarak.why: 47.8% wr: fine into mages, outclassed otherwise

plan.early: Poke with Impale through the wave, keep Harden Carapace for their mage rotation, never burn Burrow Charge in; it is your only out
plan.mid: Cocoon at 10: Burrow Charge the healer, Cocoon them, Impale the peelers. Start every objective fight with your engage or don't start it
plan.fight: Burrow the backline mage, Cocoon the healer, then turn and Impale divers off your carry. No charge without follow-up in range
plan.late: Epicenter at 16 widens your engage, but sustained AAs melt you late. Carapace eats spell burst; disengage when it is down

anubarak.solo: Can offlane vs casters thanks to Harden Carapace spell shield, but AA bruisers like Leoric and Sonya run him out of lane

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts them so your Burrow Charge and Impale land the follow-up stun chain
combos.jaina: Jaina's Ring of Frost roots the clump for your Burrow Charge unburrow stun to catch them all
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan's Impaling Blades holds them for your Cocoon and Impale to lock down the pick
combos.greymane: Greymane's Go for the Throat finishes the target your Cocoon isolates and Impale stuns

plan.early: Trade with Twin Blades then back off; Blade Dash through the wave to cycle Shield Overload. Don't spend Dash as pure damage
plan.mid: Suppression Pulse at 10: blind their AA core as fights start, then Phase Prism swap their squishiest into your team
plan.fight: Prism-swap the backline carry into your team, Dash out after. Engage when Shield Overload is up, disengage when it is down
plan.late: You win long brawls: Force of Will at 16 keeps shields rolling. Blinds and roots kill you; hold Dash to escape, not chase

artanis.solo: Solid solo: out-trades sustain bruisers with Twin Blades and shield cycling; blinds (Johanna, Li Li) and Leoric make his lane miserable

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls a target to you, chaining into your Phase Prism swap and Blade Dash burst
combos.arthas: Arthas Howling Blast root and Frozen Tempest slow hold the clump for your Suppression Pulse and Blade Dash
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts them while your Purifier Beam and Blade Dash melt the held clump
combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots pins them for your Phase Prism pull and Purifier Beam to land

blaze.why: 52.5% wr: tanky waveclear, strong on nearly every map

plan.early: Hit BOTH Flame Streams on the enemy laner, drop Oil Spill on globes to zone, hold Jet Propulsion strictly for ganks
plan.mid: Bunker Drop at 10: drop it ON your team when their burst lands; everyone ports in, walks out with flamethrowers rolling
plan.fight: Ignite Oil Spill under their divers, body-block for your carry, save Jet to peel. Bunker beats Mosh and Apocalypse combos
plan.late: Juggernaut Plating at 16 makes you unkillable in oil, but percent damage still shreds you. Never fight with Bunker on CD

blaze.solo: Comfortable solo: double-soaks with long-range streams and bullies melee bruisers; Leoric and Malthael percent damage beat him

combos.arthas: Arthas Frozen Tempest slows the clump into your Oil Spill ignite and Combustion burn
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan's Impaling Blades holds them for your Bunker Drop peel and Combustion ignite
combos.maiev: Maiev's Containment Disc pins a target for your Jet Propulsion charge and Oil Spill burn
combos.malfurion: Malfurion's Entangling Roots roots them into your Oil Spill and Jet Propulsion stun for the kill

chen.why: 48.0% wr but 27% ban: brew sustain bullies melee, very strong lately

plan.early: Keg Smash into Breath of Fire, weave AAs to refill brew. Drink behind the wave and bait their interrupt before committing
plan.mid: Wandering Keg at 10: bowl their team off the objective or roll one tank into your side. Never keg enemies onto your own backline
plan.fight: Stagger their engage: Flying Kick the diver, Keg Smash slow, drink through the burst. Your job is soaking CDs, not chasing kills
plan.late: You win by attrition, but every stun cancels your brew. Bait CC first, drink after; Purifying Brew at 20 removes that weakness

chen.solo: Strong solo: out-sustains Sonya and Mal'Ganis style traders; Yrel and stun-heavy laners who cancel Fortifying Brew bully him

combos.tyrael: Tyrael's El'druin's Might and Sanctification dome let your Flying Kick and Breath of Fire dive safely
combos.greymane: Greymane's Darkflight dive doubles on the target your Flying Kick and Keg Smash trap
combos.rehgar: Rehgar's Earthbind Totem slow and Bloodlust turn your Breath of Fire and Keg Smash dive into a kill
combos.abathur: Abathur's Symbiote shields and spikes you while your Wandering Keg rolls their backline apart

dva.why: 51.5% wr: two health bars, self-peel, objective stalling

plan.early: Boosters between two lanes to double-soak; de-meched, Big Shot the wave, hero hits refund Call Mech. Matrix their AA laner in trades
plan.mid: Bunny Hop at 10: wait for their frontline to commit, then hop the clump and keep 3+ perma-stunned on the objective
plan.fight: Defense Matrix the Tychus or Valla, Boosters to peel your healer, throw Self-Destruct into the choke as zone denial
plan.late: Losing mech to CC plus burst mid-fight is your death spiral: Matrix BEFORE stuns land, keep Self-Destruct charged for resets

dva.solo: Great solo: absurdly hard to kill and Boosters double-soak; Leoric out-trades pilot form and percent damage melts the mech

combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Balls their backline into the center of your Self-Destruct radius
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc locks a hero inside your Self-Destruct blast zone
combos.falstad: Falstad Mighty Gust pushes them back onto your ticking Self-Destruct mech
combos.deckard: Deckard Scroll of Sealing roots them where your Self-Destruct bomb will detonate

diablo.note: Flip combos near walls, feed souls first

plan.early: Stack souls fast: trade with Shadow Charge into Overpower under your own gate, Fire Stomp the wave. At 100 souls play fearless
plan.mid: Lightning Breath at 10: flip a target with Overpower first, then breathe while Unstoppable. Charge their mage on objectives
plan.fight: Charge a squishy into your team, or Overpower their diver back onto your carry as the peel. Aim Fire Stomps into the clump
plan.late: Hellgate at 20 flips fights alone, but at 0 souls you are paper. Never chain deaths; the 100-soul buff IS your tankiness

diablo.solo: Workable solo with Fire Stomp sustain, punishes immobile laners near walls; percent damage and Garrosh tosses ruin him

combos.thrall: Thrall Sundering walls and stuns them into your Shadow Charge and Overpower slam
combos.tassadar: Tassadar Force Wall traps them in place for your Apocalypse stun and Overpower combo
combos.medivh: Medivh Polymorph disables a target so you land Shadow Charge into Overpower cleanly
combos.tyrande: Tyrande Lunar Flare stuns them for your Shadow Charge, Overpower, and Apocalypse chain

etc.note: Mosh threat wins fights, powerslide engage
etc.why: 48.6% wr: Mosh into a stacked team still swings games

plan.early: Play safe soak, heal with Guitar Solo, slide only through the wave with an exit. Powerslide is engage AND escape, never both
plan.mid: Mosh Pit at 10: slide-stun only when it does not risk your Mosh; Face Melt their engage, then Mosh the re-clump on objectives
plan.fight: Powerslide the backline, hold Mosh for a 3+ clump, count their interrupts first. Face Melt peels divers off your healer
plan.late: A landed late Mosh wins the game and a cancelled one loses it. Track every enemy stun and channel-breaker before you press R

etc.solo: Rarely solos; only offlane on huge maps with a Stage Dive build, otherwise keep him main tank

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse lifts their team, then you channel Mosh Pit uninterrupted
combos.greymane: Greymane Worgen dive burst cleans up the heroes your Mosh Pit stun-locks
combos.uther: Uther Hammer of Justice stuns anyone trying to interrupt your Mosh Pit channel
combos.alarak: Alarak Deadly Charge stuns their group together for your full Mosh Pit

garrosh.note: Throw divers into your team, anti-dive king
garrosh.why: 53.6% wr + 39% ban: throw into your team is a free kill

plan.early: Trade under your tower: Groundbreaker pull, Wrecking Ball toss into tower shots, Bloodthirst back up. You are strongest at low HP
plan.mid: Decimate at 10: spam the slow on objectives and toss their bruiser into your team the second your mage has cooldowns
plan.fight: Toss the diver off your healer, or flip their carry into your team. Armor Up means you tank BETTER while low; don't panic out
plan.late: Late, every Wrecking Ball should trade a kill. Watch for Unstoppable and Iron Skin timers; toss the target who cannot answer

garrosh.solo: Fine solo: nearly ungankable at low HP under tower; loses pure sustain wars to Mal'Ganis and percent-damage laners

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them so you walk in and Wrecking Ball the frozen backline
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns a target for your Groundbreaker and Wrecking Ball toss
combos.zarya: Zarya Graviton Surge pulls their team together for your Warlord's Challenge taunt
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a carry for you to Wrecking Ball into your team

johanna.why: 52.3% wr + 55% ban, most banned hero: safe, blind-pickable, unkillable

plan.early: Punish the melee laner on CD, Shield Glare their AA windows, Iron Skin AFTER their stun commits. Condemn drags the wave for clears
plan.mid: Blessed Shield at 10: open fights by stunning two, or bank it to interrupt Mosh Pit and Ring of Frost on objectives
plan.fight: Walk at their carry, Condemn pull into Punish, keep the AA hero Glared all fight. Iron Skin their engage; you cannot be peeled
plan.late: Your risk is tanking with no threat: hit multi-hero Glares for Holy Renewal at 16 and hold Iron Skin to eat their wombo

johanna.solo: Safe solo into anything and blunts AA bruisers with Glare; low kill threat means Dehaka or Leoric happily out-soak her

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes their group for your Condemn pull and Blessed Shield
combos.blaze: Blaze Bunker Drop and Flame Stream corral them into your Condemn stun radius
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc traps a hero for your Falling Sword and Punish follow-up
combos.deckard: Deckard Scroll of Sealing roots them into your Condemn pull and Blessed Shield

malganis.why: 49.6% wr: sleep + sustain, fell off after nerfs

plan.early: Weave AAs between Fel Claws swipes, the third swipe stuns for a free trade. Necrotic Embrace shrugs poke; sleep ganks with Night Rush
plan.mid: Carrion Swarm at 10: stun with the third Fel Claws swipe, then swarm through 3+ heroes to heal back to full mid-fight
plan.fight: Night Rush their healer to sleep, chain Fel Claws stuns onto the carry. Every extra hero you hit is extra healing; fight in the pile
plan.late: Plague Bats at 16 turns swarm into a fight-winner; hard CC during it is your death. Bait stuns, then commit and outlast them

malganis.solo: Elite solo sustain: out-heals nearly every bruiser trade; ranged offlaners and healing reduction (Ana) neuter him

combos.kelthuzad: Kel'Thuzad Chains roots the group for your Fel Claws and Carrion Swarm sweep
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost locks them inside your Night Rush and Fel Claws
combos.sonya: Sonya Wrecking Ball or dive pairs with your Sleep to lock a target down
combos.illidan: Illidan dives in while your Sleep and Vampiric bulk keep the engage alive

muradin.why: 47.8% wr on a huge sample, but the safest tank floor in the game

plan.early: Hold Storm Bolt until Thunder Clap's slow guarantees it, soak and let Second Wind top you off, Dwarf Toss over terrain resets ganks
plan.mid: Avatar at 10: pop it entering the objective fight and eat their CC as the sponge; if it is down, do not start fights
plan.fight: Peel first: Thunder Clap the divers, Storm Bolt the kill target when your team commits, Dwarf Toss out last
plan.late: Avatar plus Second Wind is near-immortal vs spell comps, but Tychus-style percent damage ignores it. Never Toss INTO five

muradin.solo: Classic safe solo: escapes any gank with Dwarf Toss and heals it off; sustain traders like Mal'Ganis slowly win the lane

combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns first so your Dwarf Toss in and Storm Bolt chain the lockdown
combos.kerrigan: Kerrigan Impaling Blades roots the group for your Storm Bolt and Thunder Clap to pile on
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range so your Dwarf Toss and Storm Bolt collapse on the target
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for your Storm Bolt stun and Thunder Clap slow to stick

stitches.note: One hook wins the fight, play brush
stitches.why: 47.2% wr: hook value is real, everything else is slow

plan.early: Hook only clean lanes, it stops on minions. Slam clears and dismounts roamers; Devour the bruiser to out-sustain trades
plan.mid: Gorge at 10: Hook the healer, walk them into your team, then Gorge whoever comes to save them. Hold Hook to break channels
plan.fight: One button wins it: Hook their carry into five allies. Follow with Gorge on the second target, Slam slow to peel after
plan.late: Master Hooker at 20 makes picks constant: hook from fog, never from plain sight. A missed hook means playing the fight 4v5

stitches.solo: Decent solo: Devour keeps him topped forever; percent damage (Malthael, Tychus flex) and slippery laners like Dehaka beat him

combos.blaze: Blaze Combustion slows them so your Hook lands and Slam grinds the clump
combos.falstad: Falstad Mighty Gust pushes them together so your Slam and Putrid Bile hit the whole group
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns so your Hook and Gorge pull the target out for the team
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for a guaranteed Hook into Slam and Gorge

tyrael.why: 56.2% wr on a real sample: sanctification answers every engage

plan.early: Poke with El'druin's Might and teleport back out, Smite the wave edge for move speed rotations, Righteousness BEFORE damage lands
plan.mid: Judgment at 10 to dive carries after escapes are down; take Sanctification instead when they run Mosh or KTZ wombo
plan.fight: El'druin in, Righteousness your diver, Smite speed the chase. Even dying works: your death bomb zones their backline
plan.late: You enable the carry, not yourself: hold Sanctification for their R combo. Sancting nothing is how late fights get lost

tyrael.solo: Flex solo: very safe with El'druin escapes but low kill pressure; Arthas and Blaze out-trade him all lane

combos.illidan: Illidan dives and pins the backline so your El'druin blink and Judgment land clean
combos.alarak: Alarak Deadly Charge stuns a group so your Judgment and Righteousness follow up
combos.sgthammer: Sgt. Hammer Concussive Blast knocks back and stuns so your Judgment charge connects
combos.ltmorales: Lt. Morales Healing Beam sustains you as you dive in with Judgment and Righteousness

chogall.note: Two heads one body, only with a duo partner

plan.early: Two players, one body: soak the safest lane, Cho lands close-range Rune Bombs so Gall detonates Runic Blast on cooldown
plan.mid: Hammer of Twilight plus Twisting Nether at 10: Surging Fist in, Hammer stun, Nether the clump; Gall never stops Shadowflame
plan.fight: You ARE the frontline: Fist their carry, Hammer the peeler, Gall dumps Shadowflame and Dread Orb nonstop. Leave at 50%, not 20%
plan.late: You feed double XP when you die: never get caught solo. C'Thun's Gift and Twilight Frenzy at 20 win any grouped fight

combos.ana: Ana's Nano Boost and Healing Dart amp Gall's burst and sustain your massive shared health bar
combos.auriel: Auriel's Ray of Heaven burst-heals your huge shared HP while Crystal Aegis covers your Surging Fist dive
combos.brightwing: Brightwing's Blink Heal and Pixie Dust keep your two-headed body alive through a deep Surging Fist engage
combos.yrel: Yrel's Sanctification dome and Gift of the Naaru heal cover your Ogre Hurl dive and Gall's burst

dehaka.why: 50.7% wr + 14% ban: global bruiser, drags win games

plan.early: Soak two lanes with Brushstalker, eat essence globs, and save the Essence Collection burst heal for when a gank actually lands.
plan.mid: Isolation at 10: silence-blind their carry, then Drag them into your team. Brushstalker to the objective the second it spawns.
plan.fight: Ambush from a bush, weave an auto first, then Drag the backliner over the wall into your team. Hold essence until they burn burst.
plan.late: Late you win on cross-map Brushstalker picks; Isolation plus Drag makes every fight 4v5. Kite comps like Valla are your death.

dehaka.solo: Safe, sustainy solo laner who bullies immobile bruisers and never misses soak; ranged kite laners and blind comps outlast him.

combos.anubarak: Anub'arak Cocoon pins a hero so your Drag and Isolation land uncontested for the kill
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them in place for your Drag pull and free melee burst
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range, setting up your Drag and Isolation silence
combos.maiev: Maiev Containment Disc traps a hero for your guaranteed Drag and Isolation follow-up

deathwing.why: 52.2% wr: unstoppable stat monster, punishes cc-light comps

plan.early: Land at full armor, clear waves in World Breaker from range, and lift out before the plates melt. Never fight below half armor.
plan.mid: Cataclysm the objective start: the burn zone forces them off the point. Drop Destroyer form on their backline when your team commits.
plan.fight: You are permanently unstoppable: land on the clump, Onslaught stun the carry, Incinerate, then Dragonflight out before you go red.
plan.late: Late the risk is percent damage, Tychus and Giant Killer shred plates. Leave at half armor, reset in the sky, re-drop for round two.

deathwing.solo: Fine solo pick: World Breaker poke bullies melee bruisers who cannot trade back; Malthael and percent-damage laners send him home.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit locks a clump in place for your Molten Flame breath and Lava Burst to roast them all
combos.arthas: Arthas Howling Blast roots a target and Frozen Tempest slows the group under your Molten Flame breath
combos.johanna: Johanna's Condemn pulls them into one pile for your Firestorm and Molten Flame to melt
combos.muradin: Muradin's Stormbolt stun and Haymaker knockback pin a target under your Molten Flame breath

gazlowe.note: Zone bully, take camps on cooldown
gazlowe.why: 55.2% wr: turret zone control bullies most solo laners

plan.early: Hide Rock-It Turrets in bushes by the wave, Xplodium under it, collect scrap. You outclear everyone, so shove and take early camps.
plan.mid: Grav-O-Bomb at 10: hold it until they clump on the objective, pull them into Xplodium's stun, then turrets and Deth Lazor eat the pile.
plan.fight: Set turrets BEFORE the fight and make them come to your nest. Grav-O into Xplodium is the wombo; never open with the bomb alone.
plan.late: Late you win zone control: pre-stack turret nests on the point. Long-range poke like Chromie dismantles the nest before anyone enters.

gazlowe.solo: Sturdy solo laner on his turret nest; melee who must step into it lose, but ranged laners like Lunara poke him off his scrap for free.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds them still over your Xplodium Charge and Deth Lazor
combos.diablo: Diablo Apocalypse stuns their team into your Grav-O-Bomb and turret crossfire
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them on top of your Xplodium Charge detonation
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins a target for your Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge

plan.early: Charge the bruiser through the minion line, stack Valor with W and E, consume with AAs. Flash of Anger at 7 wins every trade
plan.mid: Wrath of the Angiris at 10: lift the carry and drop them inside your team, but only when follow-up CC is ready to land
plan.fight: Lay Solarion's Fire, Charge-pin their carry along it, Molten Armor the marked target. Vs dive, save Charge to peel your healer
plan.late: Late Wraths must hit the carry with your team set to catch; you are airborne and useless for 2s, so time it as the opener

imperius.solo: Top-tier solo bully: beats Sonya, Artanis, and The Butcher head-on; ranged kiters and Sgt. Hammer deny his Charge

combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost freezes them for your Celestial Charge and Solarion's Flare burst
combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds them still for your Solarion's Flare and Valorous Brand burst
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Earthbind Totem roots a target for your Celestial Charge stun follow-up
combos.malganis: Mal'Ganis Fel Claws stun sets up your Celestial Charge and Wrath of the Angiris

leoric.note: Percent-damage tank shredder, never truly dies

plan.early: Skeletal Swing slow first so the full Drain Hope channel sticks; even dead you keep soaking as Undying, so never leave lane XP
plan.mid: Entomb at 10: box the healer against a wall on the objective, Drain Hope inside while your team collapses on them
plan.fight: March at the biggest health bar, Drain their tank's percent HP, Wraith Walk through bodies to reach the healer. Die AFTER it's won
plan.late: Buried Alive at 20 removes their carry for 4s: open fights with it. Mobile heroes walk out of Entomb; trap against walls only

leoric.solo: Premier solo soaker: even his corpse soaks XP; Dehaka out-rotates him and Samuro or Tracer dodge everything he throws

combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge knocks a target into your Skeletal Swing and Drain Hope
combos.orphea: Orphea Dread pulls enemies in for your Skeletal Swing and Entomb wall
combos.stukov: Stukov Lurking Arm silences a group inside your Entomb trap
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost locks them for your Entomb and Skeletal Swing combo

malthael.note: Melts tanks, useless into ranged kite
malthael.why: 55.4% wr: percent damage shreds tanks and bruisers

plan.early: One Death Shroud marks the whole wave and Soul Rip heals it back. Trade into any melee freely, your percent damage always wins.
plan.mid: Last Rites at 10: mark, shave them under the execute line, cash it. Do not sit on it, a guaranteed kill is worth the cooldown.
plan.fight: Live on their frontline: keep two or three marked, Soul Rip on cooldown, Wraith Strike through the tank to tag the backline when safe.
plan.late: Late you melt 20-stack tanks and Last Rites the biggest one at 25 percent. Blinds and kiting blank you, pick your moment to stick.

malthael.solo: Solid solo vs tanky bruisers he shreds with marks; Fenix and ranged offlaners kite him and Lunara's poison outtrades Soul Rip.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit holds the team while your Reaper's Mark and Death Shroud drain them
combos.garrosh: Garrosh Wrecking Ball groups enemies for your Wraith Strike dive and Tormented Souls
combos.medivh: Medivh Portal and Force of Will let your Wraith Strike dive deep and escape
combos.ana: Ana Nano Boost supercharges your Tormented Souls teamfight drain

ragnaros.why: 49.2% wr: lava wave wins push maps

plan.early: Offlane: Empower Sulfuras clears the wave and heals in one swing, Living Meteor the camp. Trade around trait, back off without it.
plan.mid: Lava Wave at 10: send it down the opposite lane the moment the objective starts. It erases the wave and forces a defender home.
plan.fight: Second-line bruiser: let your tank open, then Empower cleave their front and Blast Wave out. Never lead, you have no escape when focused.
plan.late: Late, Molten Core turns a fort defense into a won fight; Sulfuras Smash the CC'd clump. Displacement like Garrosh ruins your trait.

ragnaros.solo: Premier solo laner: Empower sustain beats most bruisers and he never misses soak; Chen and Garrosh displacement give him fits.

combos.etc: ETC Mosh Pit pins a clump so your Living Meteor rolls through them for the full duration
combos.hanzo: Hanzo Dragon's Arrow stuns from range so your Living Meteor and Sulfuras Smash land clean
combos.kaelthas: Kael'thas Gravity Lapse stuns so your Living Meteor and Empower Sulfuras hit uncontested
combos.ana: Ana Nano Boost amps your damage so Living Meteor and Molten Core swings burn them down

rexxar.note: Solo lane + camps, Misha peels dive
rexxar.why: 57.9% wr but thin sample: misha controls the solo lane

plan.early: Send Misha into the wave while you auto from range; park her in the gank bush. You never miss soak and duo camps early with her.
plan.mid: Unleash the Boars at 10: fire it as they rotate to the objective to reveal and slow all five, then collapse with the Misha stun.
plan.fight: Misha, Charge! the diver off your healer and body-block skillshots with her; you stay on the edge with autos and Spirit Swoop slows.
plan.late: Late you split the map: Misha holds a lane or point alone while you fight. Mobile assassins who ignore Misha and jump you are the risk.

rexxar.solo: Elite solo laner: Misha tanks while Rexxar soaks for free, bullying Azmodan and Xul; hard divers like Illidan kill him through her.

combos.johanna: Johanna Blessed Shield stuns so your Misha, Charge! and Spirit Swoop chain the lockdown
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost roots the group for your Misha, Charge! and Spirit Swoop to pile on
combos.malfurion: Malfurion Entangling Roots pins them for your Misha, Charge! stun and Spirit Swoop slow

sonya.why: 48.3% wr: classic solo laner, dives well

plan.early: Offlane: Whirlwind through the full wave to heal, Ancient Spear whoever tries to leave. Solo your camp at 5, she takes it fastest.
plan.mid: Wrath of the Berserker at 10: pop it, Spear in, keep swinging so Fury extends it. Use it to shrug slows and stuns, not as a finisher.
plan.fight: Spear their backline only with follow-up; otherwise Whirlwind the frontline and be unkillable. Wrath halves stun and root duration.
plan.late: Late you out-duel anyone and solo bosses. Silences and Tychus melt you mid-Whirlwind, so count their CC before you commit the Spear.

sonya.solo: Top-tier solo bruiser: Whirlwind sustain wins almost every melee matchup; Leoric drains her and blind or kite lanes shut her down.

combos.muradin: Muradin Storm Bolt stuns so your Ancient Spear and Seismic Slam pile onto the held target
combos.jaina: Jaina Ring of Frost roots them so your Whirlwind and Seismic Slam grind the frozen clump
combos.medivh: Medivh Portal drops you onto the backline and Force of Will shields your Whirlwind dive
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Bloodlust and Chain Heal fuel your dive so Whirlwind and Seismic Slam stay lethal

thrall.why: 51.4% wr on a big sample: reliable sustain bruiser

plan.early: Feral Spirit the wave then poke with Chain Lightning; Frostwolf Resilience heals every trade. The wolf root starts every gank.
plan.mid: Sundering at 10: split their team on the objective or wall the carry off from the healer, then root and Windfury the stranded half.
plan.fight: Second-wave assassin: let the tank engage, then Windfury onto the CC'd target and wolf-root the peel. Never lead the charge yourself.
plan.late: Late a good Sundering wins the fight alone; keep trait stacks banked before you engage. Kite comps that deny his autos starve him.

thrall.solo: Can offlane vs melee, trait sustain and the wolf root punish hard, but self-sustain bruisers like Johanna and Arthas outlast him.

combos.diablo: Diablo Shadow Charge stuns a target for your Feral Spirit root and Chain Lightning
combos.fenix: Fenix Purification Salvo softens the target you burst with Chain Lightning and Windfury
combos.chromie: Chromie Slowing Sands glues enemies down so your Chain Lightning and Windfury connect
combos.rehgar: Rehgar Earthbind Totem slows a target so your Feral Spirit lands and you stick to it

varian.note: Flex pick: taunt tank or twin blades carry
varian.why: 50.9% wr: flexible tank or damage, jack of all trades

plan.early: Trade with Lion's Fang and Parry the big auto; your spike is level 4 when the heroic comes online. Shove, then join the first gank.
plan.mid: Pick at 4: Taunt if you must tank, Twin Blades to carry, Smash for burst. On objectives open by Charge-Taunting their key damage.

plan.early: Poke Sand Blast on cooldown from max range and finish Timewalker's Pursuit; you outrange everyone, never take return fire.
plan.mid: At her early 10 take Slowing Sands: drop it on the objective choke and Dragon's Breath anyone who sits in the slow.
plan.fight: Sit two screens back, spam Sand Blast into their frontline, and save Time Trap for the Zeratul or Tracer coming for you.
plan.late: Late you outrange keeps and win every poke war, but one dive kills you; never move without a Time Trap planted behind you.

plan.late: Late, Flight lets you soak and still make every fight; dying to stealth ganks mid-rotation is how you throw it.

valla.why: 49.5% wr on the biggest sample: reliable ranged damage

plan.early: Keep Hatred at 10 stacks by tagging something every 5 seconds, clear with Multishot, and treat Vault as your escape, not a toy.
plan.mid: Rain of Vengeance at 10: hold it to peel the diver off you or to chain stuns after your tank engages, never as opening poke.
plan.fight: Max-range autos on the closest safe target, Multishot to reveal stealth, and Vault away the instant a melee turns toward you.
plan.late: Manticore at 16 shreds tanks; late you win any autos-only fight but die to one gank, so never walk the map alone.

zagara.why: 48.5% wr: lane bully, falls off in fights

plan.early: Plant creep tumors every trip, shove with Banelings plus Infested Drop, and out-rotate: your speed and vision on creep win the map.
plan.mid: Devouring Maw at 10: swallow their healer plus a chaser on engage and kill the players left outside before it spits them back.
plan.fight: Sit max range on creep, Hunter Killer the squishiest target, Infested Drop on cooldown, and never get caught off creep by a diver.
plan.late: Late, shove side lanes before every fight and seed tumors deep; if they group your push wins, if they split Maw punishes the 4v5.

zagara.solo: Strong solo laner on big maps: trades with Hunter Killer, soaks safely behind creep vision, and is hard to gank on her own turf.

plan.early: Gank with Cleave burst from stealth, Blink in only when the exit is safe, and take camps between ganks; you don't sit in a lane.
plan.mid: Void Prison at 10: trap half their team on the objective and kill the outsiders, or Prison the rescuer to seal a pick.
plan.fight: Cleave plus autos on the healer, Blink to disjoint the return skillshot, Wormhole back out, re-stealth, and re-enter on cooldown.
plan.late: Late one good Prison wins the game: cut their frontline from backline at the choke; the risk is face-checking bushes into CC chains.

plan.early: Angle Twin Cleave through the wave onto their hero, channel Regeneration only from fog, and stack You Want Axe? without dying.
plan.mid: Taz'dingo at 10: flip it the moment their combo starts, then Berserker to max attack speed and stand in their face for 4 free seconds.
plan.fight: Ride low health on purpose for trait attack speed, shred the nearest tank, and Taz'dingo turns their all-in into your best fight.
plan.late: Amani Resilience at 20 makes Taz'dingo heal you back up; your real risk is being stunned before you press it, watch their CC first.

murky.note: Annoyance engine, trades time for value

plan.early: Hide the Egg deep in bushes, shove nonstop with Slime and Pufferfish, and trade your cheap deaths for their cooldowns and XP.
plan.mid: Octo-Grab at 10: waddle in and lock their healer or Hammer as your team dives, and call the target first so the stun isn't wasted.
plan.fight: Be the distraction: soak abilities up front, Safety Bubble through the burst, and Slime everything so your team cleans up the slowed mess.
plan.late: Late your death still only costs them time: keep the Egg moved, push the lane your team isn't in, and Grab the carry when they group.

murky.solo: Classic nuisance offlaner: rarely wins the 1v1 kill but never leaves, out-soaks through Egg respawns, and starves their bruiser.

plan.early: Offlane: keep Carnage bleeds rolling and pop Blood Rage to heal off the wave plus the laner. Grappling Hook over terrain for free ganks.
plan.mid: Final Strike at 10: bleed them down, Revolving Sweep to stick, then line the execute through both carries on the objective.
plan.fight: Revolving Sweep their carry to dodge damage while attached, drop the stun, spread bleeds, Blood Rage once three are marked.
plan.late: Late she snipes kills with Final Strike off any chip damage; knockback peel like E.T.C. blanks Sweep, engage after their CC is burned.

qhira.solo: Strong solo laner: bleeds plus Blood Rage outsustain most bruisers and Hook makes her ungankable; hard CC ganks and Yrel beat her.

lostvikings.note: Triple soak wins XP, needs macro brain
lostvikings.why: 53.9% wr on 104 games: macro gods in expert hands, useless otherwise

plan.early: Three lanes, three Vikings: Olaf takes the dangerous lane, Erik roams the edges, Baleog clears; soak every wave, hit talent spikes first.
plan.mid: Play Again at 10 on big maps: keep soaking until the objective goes live, then summon all three in fresh; Erik stalls channels.
plan.fight: Never clump: Olaf body-blocks and charges to peel, Baleog spins the wave, Erik kites wide; losing one Viking is fine, three is a wipe.
plan.late: The XP lead is the win condition: you reach 20 first, so force fights at your spike and never let a Viking die shown on the map.

lostvikings.solo: Not one solo laner but three: they win the soak war outright, and collapsing on one Viking still leaves two earning elsewhere.

plan.late: Frostmourne Hungers plus Remorseless Winter at 16 melts anyone in melee; displacement is death, so hug your team and walls

arthas.solo: Strong solo vs melee: Frozen Tempest ruins AA bruisers; ranged offlaners kite him for free and Ana cuts his self-heal

hogger.why: 54.2% wr, unanimous S in every source: rage sustain + wall slams

plan.early: Throw Loot Hoard for the meat heal, Staggering Blow enemies into it or walls for stuns, keep Rage above 50 by trading often
plan.mid: Hoardapult at 10: launch onto their backline at objectives, Hogg Wild spin the clump, Staggering Blow stragglers into terrain
plan.fight: Pin their carry to a wall with Staggering Blow, point-blank Ez-Thro Dynamite so it pops instantly, spin out with Hogg Wild
plan.late: No wall means no stun: pick fight locations first. Stay above 50 Rage for the armor or you fall over in seconds

hogger.solo: Premier offlaner: wins most melee matchups with wall stuns and meat sustain; poke ranged like Lunara starve him out

maiev.note: Cage the fight, umbral bind cleave
maiev.why: 46.9% wr this patch (volatile): cage plays still win fights

plan.early: Fan of Knives resets clear waves instantly; rotate and set ganks with Umbral Bind from bushes. Hold Vault to escape, never to engage.
plan.mid: Containment Disc at 10: disc the healer or a Cho'gall at objective start, then Umbral Bind the rest back into your team's AoE.
plan.fight: Spirit of Vengeance in, Umbral Bind two or more, drag them back into your team. Hold Fan of Knives until it hits at least two heroes.
plan.late: Late she chain-fights off Fan resets and the Disc pick decides fights. Unstoppable and cleanse blank the Bind, track those cooldowns.

maiev.solo: Not a real solo laner: no sustain and her value is roam ganks; if forced, clear fast with Fan and rotate rather than trade.

mei.why: 47.9% wr: stall kit, low kill pressure

plan.early: Offlane on blind uptime: Snow Blind every trade so melee whiff, Icing out of ganks, Cryo-Freeze baits their full combo for free.
plan.mid: Ice Wall at 10: cut their frontline off from the healer on the objective, or wall the choke so they enter the fight in halves.
plan.fight: Peel machine: blind the enemy auto-attacker on cooldown, Blizzard the clump for the stun, Cryo-Freeze the burst aimed at you.
plan.late: Late one good Ice Wall wins the fight before it starts; the risk is walling YOUR team wrong. Breathe, cut their backline, not yours.

mei.solo: Great solo lane vs auto-attack melee: Snow Blind makes Butcher and Illidan whiff; loses to poke like Hanzo who never touches her blind.
